title: The Sunday Read: ‘The Vanishing Family: Life in the Shadow of a Cruel Genetic Mutation’

sentences.en: 33 presidents.
sentences.zh: 33位总统。

sentences.en: I called the president at 4.30 in the morning and he answered.
sentences.zh: 我在凌晨4点30分给总统打了电话，他接了。

sentences.en: Seven decades in space.
sentences.zh: 漫步太空七十年。

sentences.en: We want to see what's beyond the next star.
sentences.zh: 我们想看看下一颗星辰之外有什么。

sentences.en: A thousand consumer product guides.
sentences.zh: 上千份消费品指南。

sentences.en: Today I am testing seven mattresses.
sentences.zh: 今天我要测试七款床垫。

sentences.en: 60 super sundaes.
sentences.zh: 60款超级圣代。

sentences.en: They were probably the best team in the league every single year.
sentences.zh: 他们可能每年都是联赛中最棒的球队。

sentences.en: 53,500 puzzles.

sentences.zh: 我每天都用不同的起始单词。

sentences.zh: 而且我很喜欢单锅菜谱，因为我讨厌洗锅。

sentences.en: The New York Times, celebrating 175 years of helping you understand the world and make the most of each day.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》庆祝成立175周年，陪伴您理解世界，过好每一天。

sentences.en: Subscribe now for a special offer at nytimes.com slash subscribe.
sentences.zh: 立即订阅，享受特惠，网址 nytimes.com 斜杠 subscribe。

sentences.en: Hi, I'm Robert Kolker and I'm a contributing writer to The New York Times magazine.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我是罗伯特·科尔克（Robert Kolker），我是《纽约时报杂志》的特约撰稿人。

sentences.en: This is a story about a family.
sentences.zh: 这是一个关于家庭的故事。

sentences.en: There doesn't seem to be anything extraordinary about this particular family at all, except maybe that there are a lot of siblings.
sentences.zh: 这个特殊的家庭似乎并没有什么非凡之处，也许只是兄弟姐妹特别多。

sentences.en: Nine, to be exact.
sentences.zh: 确切地说，有九个。

sentences.en: They're just middle-class Americans who mind their own business.
sentences.zh: 他们只是安分守己的中产阶级美国人。

sentences.en: A very ordinary family that wants nothing more than to just stay ordinary.
sentences.zh: 一个只想保持平凡、别无所求的普通家庭。

sentences.en: And yet, each of them have something inside their genetic code that could severely curtail their quality of life and completely change the lives of everyone around them.
sentences.zh: 然而，他们每个人的基因密码里都藏着某种东西，可能会严重缩短他们的生活质量，并彻底改变周围所有人的生活。

sentences.en: This week's Sunday Read is a story I wrote for the magazine about a family who learned that they'd inherited a genetic mutation, one that causes a rare form of dementia.
sentences.zh: 本周的“周日阅读”是我为杂志撰写的一篇文章，讲述了一个家庭发现他们遗传了一种基因突变，这种突变会导致一种罕见的痴呆症。

sentences.en: It's something called FTD, or frontotemporal dementia.
sentences.zh: 这就是所谓的FTD，即额颞叶痴呆。

sentences.en: Unlike Alzheimer's disease, FTD usually strikes in the prime of one's adult life.
sentences.zh: 与阿尔茨海默病不同，FTD通常发作于人生的黄金成年期。

sentences.en: You could be as young as, say, 40.
sentences.zh: 你可能正年轻，比如40岁。

sentences.en: And it goes after the part of the brain responsible for planning, understanding social cues, and making judgments.
sentences.zh: 它会攻击大脑中负责规划、理解社交线索和做出判断的区域。

sentences.en: In the beginning, you start to act impulsively.
sentences.zh: 一开始，你会开始冲动行事。

sentences.en: You have weird conversations with strangers.
sentences.zh: 你会和陌生人进行奇怪的对话。

sentences.en: Then, your capacity for language starts to weaken.
sentences.zh: 然后，你的语言能力开始减弱。

sentences.en: You might have a master's degree and be an expert in something, but suddenly you're talking like a fifth grader.
sentences.zh: 你可能拥有硕士学位，是某一领域的专家，但突然之间，你说话就像个五年级学生。

sentences.en: And then, as the years go on, your abilities get even more limited.
sentences.zh: 接着，随着岁月的流逝，你的能力变得更加局限。

sentences.en: Until, finally, you can't even take care of yourself.
sentences.zh: 直到最后，你甚至无法照顾自己。

sentences.en: Diagnosing this rare condition is extremely difficult, and there's currently no cure.
sentences.zh: 诊断这种罕见疾病极其困难，目前尚无治愈方法。

sentences.en: And so, it was horrifying and catastrophic for this family to learn that each of them has a 50% chance, a coin flip, of having the genetic mutation for FTD.
sentences.zh: 因此，对这个家庭来说，得知他们每个人都有50%的几率——就像抛硬币一样——携带FTD基因突变，是一场可怕而灾难性的打击。

sentences.en: But then, what happened next was even more surprising, which was that some of them decided not to get tested.
sentences.zh: 但随后，更令人惊讶的事情发生了，他们中的一些人决定不去接受检测。

sentences.en: They didn't want to know, just yet.
sentences.zh: 他们还不想知道。

sentences.en: For some of them, the only thing to do was to continue living their lives, because you can't do anything about it anyway.
sentences.zh: 对他们中的一些人来说，唯一能做的就是继续生活，因为反正你也无能为力。

sentences.en: Still, that anxiety completely took up their days.
sentences.zh: 尽管如此，这种焦虑还是完全占据了他们的日子。

sentences.en: It's like walking around saying, don't think of elephants.
sentences.zh: 这就好比走来走去对你说，千万别去想大象。

sentences.en: Suddenly, you're thinking about elephants.
sentences.zh: 突然之间，你脑子里全是大象。

sentences.en: And so, it becomes this moral conundrum.
sentences.zh: 于是，这成了一个道德难题。

sentences.en: Do you need to tell your partner if you carry this genetic mutation?
sentences.zh: 如果你携带这种基因突变，你需要告诉你的伴侣吗？

sentences.en: Do you have children?
sentences.zh: 你有孩子吗？

sentences.en: And if you do, do you let them know that they might be afflicted with a debilitating disease much later in life?
sentences.zh: 如果有，你要让他们知道他们可能会在晚年患上这种使人衰弱的疾病吗？

sentences.en: When would you even tell them?
sentences.zh: 你又会在什么时候告诉他们呢？

sentences.en: When I started writing about this family, I wondered how much of this family's affliction would actually translate outside of their particular experience.
sentences.zh: 当我开始撰写关于这个家庭的文章时，我曾好奇这个家庭的苦难在多大程度上能超脱他们的特殊经历，引起共鸣。

sentences.en: But what I found was that their dilemma was quite relatable.
sentences.zh: 但我发现，他们的困境其实很容易让人感同身受。

sentences.en: We all wonder what the future holds.
sentences.zh: 我们都想知道未来会发生什么。

sentences.en: Whether it's high cholesterol or a relative having cancer, we all wonder about what we would or wouldn't want to know about our genetic destinies.
sentences.zh: 无论是高胆固醇还是亲戚患癌，我们都想知道自己是否愿意了解关于基因命运的真相。

sentences.en: About a year ago, I heard from the youngest of these nine siblings.
sentences.zh: 大约一年前，我收到了这九个兄弟姐妹中最小的一个人的来信。

sentences.en: A woman in her 40s named Barb.
sentences.zh: 一个40多岁的女人，名叫芭芭拉（Barb）。

sentences.en: I met with her personally, and we spoke at length.
sentences.zh: 我亲自见了她，我们进行了长谈。

sentences.en: The story Barb told me begins 30 years earlier when one of her sisters started to experience strange symptoMs.
sentences.zh: 芭芭拉告诉我的故事始于30年前，当时她的一个姐姐开始出现奇怪的症状。

sentences.en: This is her family's story.
sentences.zh: 这就是他们一家的故事。

sentences.en: The Vanishing Family
sentences.zh: 消逝的家族

sentences.en: Read by Eduardo Ballerini
sentences.zh: 爱德华多·巴莱里尼（Eduardo Ballerini）演播

sentences.en: Barb was the youngest in her large Irish Catholic family.
sentences.zh: 芭芭拉是她庞大的爱尔兰天主教家庭中最小的孩子。

sentences.en: A surprise baby.
sentences.zh: 一个意外出生的宝贝。

sentences.en: The ninth child.
sentences.zh: 第九个孩子。

sentences.en: Born ten years after the eighth.
sentences.zh: 出生在第八个孩子十年之后。

sentences.en: Living in the suburbs of Pittsburgh, her family followed the football schedule.
sentences.zh: 住在匹兹堡郊区，她的家庭追随着橄榄球赛程表。

sentences.en: High school games on Friday night, college games on Saturday, the Steelers on Sunday.
sentences.zh: 周五晚上是高中比赛，周六是大学比赛，周日是钢人队。

sentences.en: Dad was an engineer, mom was a homemaker, and Barb was the family mascot.
sentences.zh: 爸爸是工程师，妈妈是家庭主妇，芭芭拉则是家庭的吉祥物。

sentences.en: Blonde and adorable, watching her brothers and sisters finish school and go on to their careers.
sentences.zh: 金发碧眼，十分可爱，看着哥哥姐姐们完成学业并走向各自的职业生涯。

sentences.en: Barb was the only child left at home in the 1980s to witness the seams of her parents' marriage come apart.
sentences.zh: 在20世纪80年代，芭芭拉是家中唯一一个留下来目睹父母婚姻出现裂痕的孩子。

sentences.en: Her father all but left, and her mother turned inward, sitting quietly in front of the television, always smoking, often with a cocktail.
sentences.zh: 她的父亲几乎离家出走，母亲则变得内向，静静地坐在电视机前，总是抽着烟，常常端着一杯鸡尾酒。

sentences.en: Something had overtaken her, though it wasn't clear what.
sentences.zh: 有什么东西攫住了她，尽管尚不清楚是什么。

sentences.en: Barb observed it all with a measure of detachment.
sentences.zh: 芭芭拉带着几分冷漠注视着这一切。

sentences.en: Her parents had been older than most, and her sisters and brothers supplied more than enough parental energy to make up the difference.
sentences.zh: 她的父母比大多数人的父母年纪大，而她的哥哥姐姐们提供了多得过剩的父母之爱来弥补这一差距。

sentences.en: And so in 1990, when Barb was 14 and her mother learned she had breast cancer, and died within months at the age of 62,
sentences.zh: 因此，在1990年，当芭芭拉14岁时，她的母亲被诊断出患有乳腺癌，并在几个月内去世，享年62岁。

sentences.en: Barb was shattered and bewildered, but also protected.
sentences.zh: 芭芭拉感到心碎和迷惑，但也受到了庇护。

sentences.en: Her siblings had already stepped in, three of them living back home.
sentences.zh: 她的兄弟姐妹已经介入，其中三人搬回了家里住。

sentences.en: Together they arrived at a shared understanding of the tragedy.
sentences.zh: 他们共同对这场悲剧达成了某种理解。

sentences.en: Their mother could have lived longer if she had cut back on her drinking sooner, or gone to see a doctor, or hadn't smoked.
sentences.zh: 如果他们的母亲早点戒酒、去看医生或者不抽烟，她本可以活得更久。

sentences.en: Six years later,
sentences.zh: 六年之后，

sentences.en: Barb was 20, and in college, when someone else in the family needed help.
sentences.zh: 芭芭拉20岁，正在上大学，这时家里另一个人需要帮助了。

sentences.en: Her sister, Christy, was the secondborn,
sentences.zh: 她的姐姐克里斯蒂（Christy）是家里的老二，

sentences.en: 24 years older than Barb, and the star of the family in many ways.
sentences.zh: 比芭芭拉大24岁，在许多方面都是家里的明星。

sentences.en: She had traveled extensively as a pharmaceutical company executive while raising two children with her husband in a nice house in a New Jersey suburb.
sentences.zh: 她曾作为一家制药公司的行政人员广泛出差，与丈夫在新泽西郊区的一栋漂亮房子里抚养两个孩子。

sentences.en: But where once Christy was capable and professionally ambitious and socially conscious, now at 44, she was alone, her clothes unkempt and ripped, her hair unwashed,
sentences.zh: 但曾经能干、在职业上有雄心壮志且富有社会责任感的克里斯蒂，如今44岁却孤身一人，衣服凌乱破烂，头发没有清洗，

sentences.en: her marriage over.
sentences.zh: 婚姻也已经破裂。

sentences.en: Again, the family came together.
sentences.zh: 家族再次聚在一起。

sentences.en: Susan, the thirdborn, volunteered to take care of Christy full-time, and Jenny, the eighth, searched for a specialist, the family members asked to be identified
sentences.zh: 老三苏珊（Susan）主动提出全职照顾克里斯蒂，老八珍妮（Jenny）则寻找专家。为了保护隐私，家族成员要求使用名（first name）来指代他们。

sentences.en: by their first names to protect their privacy.
sentences.zh: 为了保护隐私，家族成员要求使用他们的名字来指代。

sentences.en: Depression was the first suspected diagnosis, then schizophrenia, though neither seemed quite right.
sentences.zh: 最初怀疑的诊断是抑郁症，然后是精神分裂症，尽管这两种听起来都不太对劲。

sentences.en: Christy wasn't sad or delusional, she wasn't even upset.
sentences.zh: 克里斯蒂并不伤心，也没有妄想，她甚至没有难过。

sentences.en: It was more as if she were reverting to a childlike state, losing her knack for self-regulation.
sentences.zh: 这更像是她回到了儿童的状态，失去了自我调节的能力。

sentences.en: Her personality was diluting.
sentences.zh: 她的个性正在被稀释。

sentences.en: On its way out was seemingly nothing to replace it.
sentences.zh: 消逝的性格似乎没有得到任何补充。

sentences.en: What was left of Christy was chaotic and unpredictable.
sentences.zh: 留在克里斯蒂身上的只有混乱和不可预测。

sentences.en: She refused to bathe and stopped bothering to make meals.
sentences.zh: 她拒绝洗澡，也不再费心去做饭。

sentences.en: She crashed a neighbor's party and made odd conversation with strangers.
sentences.zh: 她闯入邻居的派对，和陌生人进行奇怪的对话。

sentences.en: She clogged a toilet with tampons and flooded the house.
sentences.zh: 她用卫生棉条堵塞马桶，把房子淹了。

sentences.en: She was gleefully impulsive, spending thousands of dollars a year on magazine subscriptions.
sentences.zh: 她快乐地冲动着，每年花数千美元订阅杂志。

sentences.en: That strange, reckless profligacy made Barb think of their mother, who in her final years sat at home, saying yes to every sales phone call.
sentences.zh: 那种奇怪、鲁莽的挥霍让芭芭拉想起了她们的母亲，她在晚年时坐在家里，对每一个推销电话都说“好”。

sentences.en: How heartbreaking, but also interesting,
sentences.zh: 多么令人心碎，但也十分有趣，

sentences.en: Barb thought, that Christy shared the same peculiar tendencies, a family trait of sorts.
sentences.zh: 芭芭拉想，克里斯蒂有着同样的奇特倾向，某种程度上可以说是家族特质。

sentences.en: Barb was long out of college, in her early 30s, and married with two children, building a real estate career in Denver.
sentences.zh: 芭芭拉大学毕业已经很久，三十出头，已婚并有两个孩子，在丹佛建立了自己的房地产事业。

sentences.en: One night, when she was putting the kids to bed, her phone rang.
sentences.zh: 一天晚上，当她哄孩子睡觉时，电话铃响了。

sentences.en: It was Mary, the fifth born,
sentences.zh: 打来的是老五玛丽（Mary），

sentences.en: 17 years older than Barb, in town unannounced.
sentences.zh: 比芭芭拉大17岁，没有打招呼就来到了城里。

sentences.en: Can you come pick me up?
sentences.zh: 你能来接我吗？

sentences.en: She said.
sentences.zh: 她说。

sentences.en: Mary had always been one of Barb's favorite siblings.
sentences.zh: 玛丽一直是芭芭拉最喜欢的姐姐之一。

sentences.en: As a child, she was a piano prodigy, precocious and outgoing, her gaze fixed on a future beyond her hometown.
sentences.zh: 小时候，她是个钢琴神童，早熟且外向，目光投向了家乡之外的未来。

sentences.en: Mary grew up to be a mass transportation engineer, consulting on projects from New Orleans to Abu Dhabi.
sentences.zh: 玛丽长大后成为了一名大众运输工程师，从新奥尔良到阿布扎比的项目都有她的咨询身影。

sentences.en: She and her fiancé lived in Chicago, where Barb, then in her 20s, would visit, joining them for parties and nights out.
sentences.zh: 她和未婚夫住在芝加哥，当时二十多岁的芭芭拉会去那里探望他们，和他们一起参加派对和夜生活。

sentences.en: But in recent years, things had changed for Mary.
sentences.zh: 但近年来，玛丽的情况变了。

sentences.en: She was divorced and remarried with the young son, living in Omaha and only in occasional contact with the family.
sentences.zh: 她离婚后又再婚，带着一个小儿子住在奥马哈，只是偶尔和家里联系。

sentences.en: And here she was, where Barb lived, with no explanation.
sentences.zh: 而现在，她毫无解释地来到了芭芭拉居住的城市。

sentences.en: That weekend,
sentences.zh: 那个周末，

sentences.en: Barb saw it all, the same movie playing again.
sentences.zh: 芭芭拉目睹这一切，就像同一部电影再次上演。

sentences.en: Mary's affect was flat, far from the irrepressible sister she once was.
sentences.zh: 玛丽的情绪反应平淡，远不像她曾经那个不可遏制的姐姐。

sentences.en: Everyday courtesies seemed beyond her.
sentences.zh: 日常的礼节似乎对她来说都成了难事。

sentences.en: She was in town for a work trip, she said, but hadn't bothered to book a place to stay or let Barb know in advance.
sentences.zh: 她说她是来这里出差的，但却没有费心去预订住处，也没有提前通知芭芭拉。

sentences.en: When she talked about the project she was about to manage, it was with the language of a middle or high schooler, not someone with a master's degree and years of expertise.
sentences.zh: 当她谈到她即将管理的那个项目时，她用的是中学生或初中生的语言，而不是一个拥有硕士学位和多年专业经验的人。

sentences.en: As soon as Mary left,
sentences.zh: 玛丽刚一离开，

sentences.en: Barb called Mary's husband, who was at his wit's end.
sentences.zh: 芭芭拉就给玛丽的丈夫打了电话，他已经快急疯了。

sentences.en: Mary had never really bonded with their son, he said.
sentences.zh: 她说，玛丽从未真正和他们的儿子建立起感情。

sentences.en: She seemed disengaged from everything around her.
sentences.zh: 她似乎对身边的一切都漠不关心。

sentences.en: The old Mary was disappearing, with nothing to replace her.
sentences.zh: 那个老玛丽正在消失，没有任何东西能取代她。

sentences.en: That's when everything cascaded for Barb.
sentences.zh: 就在那时，芭芭拉心中的一切都崩塌了。

sentences.en: What the affliction was, exactly, she didn't know.
sentences.zh: 这究竟是什么病，她并不知道。

sentences.en: No one did.
sentences.zh: 没有人知道。

sentences.en: But two of her sisters had the same thing that must have so drastically altered their mother.
sentences.zh: 但她的两个姐姐得了和她们母亲一样的病，那病必定极大程度地改变了她们的母亲。

sentences.en: This is genetic, she thought.
sentences.zh: 这是基因遗传，她想。

sentences.en: This is inherited.
sentences.zh: 这是遗传的。

sentences.en: And then, finally, we all might have it.
sentences.zh: 然后，最终，我们所有人可能都会得这个病。

sentences.en: The others ignored Barb's concerns.
sentences.zh: 其他人忽视了芭芭拉的担忧。

sentences.en: It wasn't just that she was the youngest in the family and more easily dismissed.
sentences.zh: 这不仅因为她是家里最小的孩子，更容易被忽视。

sentences.en: It was that a few years earlier,
sentences.zh: 还因为几年前，

sentences.en: Christy had participated in some genetic tests with the University of California,
sentences.zh: 克里斯蒂曾加过加州大学旧金山分校的一些基因检测，

sentences.en: San Francisco that had gone nowhere.
sentences.zh: 但没有任何结果。

sentences.en: Based on all the available knowledge about inherited brain disease, the specialist could not find an explanation for her changing behavior.
sentences.zh: 根据所有关于遗传性脑病的现有知识，专家无法为她不断变化的行为找到一个解释。

sentences.en: But now Barb fixated on exactly what they were told.
sentences.zh: 但现在芭芭拉死死盯住他们被告知的内容。

sentences.en: How the field was in its infancy, and how just because they couldn't find a genetic marker, didn't mean one wasn't there.
sentences.zh: 关于这个领域还处于起步阶段，以及不能因为找不到基因标记就意味着它不存在。

sentences.en: Barb decided to start a search of her own.
sentences.zh: 芭芭拉决定开始自己的寻找。

sentences.en: She contacted the National Institutes of Health and learned about a condition that bore a striking resemblance to Christy's and Mary's symptoms,
sentences.zh: 她联系了美国国立卫生研究院，了解到了一种与克里斯蒂和玛丽的症状惊人相似的疾病，

sentences.en: frontotemporal dementia, or FTD, which emerges in the prime of adult life, as young as 40 in some cases, and relentlessly attacks the part of the brain responsible for planning,
sentences.zh: 即额颞叶痴呆，简称FTD。它发作于人生的黄金成年期，有些病例甚至早在40岁就会出现，并无情地攻击大脑中负责规划、

sentences.en: organizing, expressing language, understanding social cues, and exercising judgment.
sentences.zh: 组织、表达语言、理解社交线索和行使判断力的区域。

sentences.en: Unlike more common brain disorders like Alzheimer's,
sentences.zh: 与阿尔茨海默病等更常见的脑部疾病不同，

sentences.en: FTD is confoundingly rare.
sentences.zh: FTD极为罕见，令人困惑。

sentences.en: Researchers suggest that perhaps 60,000 Americans have it, though that estimate is complicated by how difficult it is to diagnose.
sentences.zh: 研究人员表示，大约有6万名美国人患有此病，尽管由于诊断困难，这一估计数字很复杂。

sentences.en: By the mid-aughts, researchers were still starting to identify and sort out the many varieties of FTD.
sentences.zh: 到了20世纪20年代中期（注：应指2000年代中期），研究人员仍在开始识别和厘清FTD的多种类型。

sentences.en: Which were hereditary?
sentences.zh: 哪些是遗传的？

sentences.en: Which weren't?
sentences.zh: 哪些不是？

sentences.en: How many were yet to be found?
sentences.zh: 还有多少有待发现？

sentences.en: Bruce Willis' family said they finally arrived at a diagnosis of FTD recently, after an earlier provisional explanation of aphasia, a condition that impacts speech
sentences.zh: 布鲁斯·威利斯（Bruce Willis）的家人表示，在早先初步解释为失语症（一种影响言语的疾病）之后，他们最近终于确诊了FTD，

sentences.en: but have not disclosed whether his FTD is inherited.
sentences.zh: 但他们没有透露他的FTD是否具有遗传性。

sentences.en: The idea that the FTD field was still developing and the knowledge base growing only made Barb more determined.
sentences.zh: FTD领域仍在发展、知识库不断丰富这一事实，反而让芭芭拉更加坚定。

sentences.en: In December 2006, she asked everyone in the family, including their father, to provide blood samples for a new round of analysis.
sentences.zh: 2006年12月，她要求家里的每个人，包括他们的父亲，都提供血液样本，以便进行新一轮的分析。

sentences.en: Christy, Jenny, and Susan agreed.
sentences.zh: 克里斯蒂、珍妮和苏珊都同意了。

sentences.en: The researchers failed to find any known FTD mutations, not surprising in retrospect, given the limited number of samples.
sentences.zh: 研究人员没有发现任何已知的FTD突变，现在回想起来并不令人意外，考虑到样本数量有限。

sentences.en: Barb's contact at the NIH encouraged her to continue testing through the Mayo Clinic.
sentences.zh: 芭芭拉在国立卫生研究院（NIH）的联系人鼓励她通过梅奥诊所继续进行检测。

sentences.en: The family remained in the dark, even as they watched Mary follow Christy's trajectory, losing all social awareness, defying common sense.
sentences.zh: 尽管眼睁睁看着玛丽走上克里斯蒂的老路，失去所有社交意识、违背常识，这个家庭依然被蒙在鼓里。

sentences.en: Then the following year, a new piece of information arrived from out of the blue.
sentences.zh: 就在第二年，一条全新的消息突如其来了。

sentences.en: when Teddy, the seventh sibling,
sentences.zh: 当时泰迪，也就是第七个孩子，

sentences.en: 11 years older than Barb, forwarded an email from a woman trying to track down distant relatives who might share the same medical problem her family seemed to be suffering from.
sentences.zh: 比芭芭拉大11岁，转发了一位女士的电子邮件。这位女士正试图寻找可能与她家人所患同一种医疗问题有关的远亲。

sentences.en: The message included a photograph of the sibling's grandfather, a shared genetic ancestor on their mother's side of the family.
sentences.zh: 邮件中附有一张兄妹俩祖父的照片，那是他们母亲家族中共同的基因祖先。

sentences.en: We had no idea that branch of the family existed,
sentences.zh: 我们根本不知道家族里还有那个分支，

sentences.en: Barb said.
sentences.zh: 芭芭拉说。

sentences.en: I mean, it was crazy.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这太疯狂了。

sentences.en: The medical problem, the woman explained later on the phone, was FTD.
sentences.zh: 这位女士后来在电话里解释说，那个医疗问题就是FTD。

sentences.en: With equal parts awe and dread,
sentences.zh: 带着既敬畏又恐惧的心情，

sentences.en: Barb contacted the Mayo Clinic, which tested both families, two strains of the same gene pool.
sentences.zh: 芭芭拉联系了梅奥诊所，该诊所对这两个家族进行了检测，它们是同一个基因库的两个分支。

sentences.en: All of Barb's siblings participated this time, gathering there in person, as well as some adult grandchildren.
sentences.zh: 芭芭拉的所有兄弟姐妹这次都参与了，大家亲自聚在那里，还有一些已成年的孙辈。

sentences.en: With so many samples spanning several generations in different wings of the family, the researchers had a better trail to follow.
sentences.zh: 拥有这么多跨越好几个世代、来自家族不同分支的样本，研究人员有了更好的线索可循。

sentences.en: Sure enough, the families had a mutation of the tau protein, which is now understood to be one of three major brain proteins associated with inherited FTD.
sentences.zh: 果不其然，这些家族拥有tau蛋白的突变，现在人们知道这是与遗传性FTD相关的三种主要大脑蛋白质之一。

sentences.en: When they came in with the news, you could tell they were elated,
sentences.zh: 当他们带着消息进来时，你能看出他们欣喜若狂，

sentences.en: Barb said.
sentences.zh: 芭芭拉说。

sentences.en: I think that's how uncommon it is to find.
sentences.zh: 我想这就是这种病有多么罕见的原因。

sentences.en: Of course, it was also a catastrophe.
sentences.zh: 当然，这也是一场灾难。

sentences.en: There is no bright side to any FTD diagnosis, no cure, no path forward.
sentences.zh: 任何FTD诊断都没有光明的一面，没有治疗方法，也没有出路。

sentences.en: With very few exceptions, everyone who inherits the mutation will, like Christy and Mary, long before their old age, develop inappropriate social behavior and lose the ability
sentences.zh: 除了极少数例外，所有遗传了这种突变的人，都会像克里斯蒂和玛丽一样，在年老之前的很长一段时间里，出现不当的社交行为，并失去能力

sentences.en: to earn an income, look after their children, do household chores, or take care of their hygiene.
sentences.zh: 去赚取收入、照顾孩子、做家务或打理个人卫生。

sentences.en: They will eventually be unable to speak, feed or dress themselves, or use the bathroom on their own.
sentences.zh: 他们最终将无法说话、自己进食或穿衣，也无法自己上厕所。

sentences.en: This is the case with Christy, who at 71 spends most days in front of the TV and has an Apple AirTag clipped to a sneaker in case she wanders off.
sentences.zh: 克里斯蒂就是这种情况，71岁的她大部分时间都在电视机前度过，运动鞋上还夹着一个Apple AirTag，以防她走失。

sentences.en: The decline may be swift, but the end may not be.
sentences.zh: 病情恶化可能会很快，但终点可能不会迅速到来。

sentences.en: Unlike Alzheimer's patients, who largely are diagnosed when they're elderly, people with FTD can potentially live many years after becoming symptomatic, requiring decades of care.
sentences.zh: 与大多在老年确诊的阿尔茨海默病患者不同，FTD患者在出现症状后可能会活很多年，需要几十年的护理。

sentences.en: And their children, all their descendants, might carry the mutation too.
sentences.zh: 而他们的孩子，所有的后代，也可能携带着这种突变。

sentences.en: Every sibling, except Susan, had children of their own.
sentences.zh: 除了苏珊，每个兄弟姐妹都有自己的孩子。

sentences.en: Kathy, the eldest, had a grandchild.
sentences.zh: 老大凯西甚至有一个孙辈。

sentences.en: They had all inherited, in essence, a coin flip, a 50% chance that they carry the mutation.
sentences.zh: 从本质上讲，他们都继承了一次掷硬币的结果，有50%的几率携带这种突变。

sentences.en: Those who don't carry it are in the clear, and so are their descendants.
sentences.zh: 那些没有携带的人就没事了，他们的后代也是。

sentences.en: Those who do will develop FTD.
sentences.zh: 而那些携带的人将会患上FTD。

sentences.en: And they pass along that same 50% risk to each of their children.
sentences.zh: 并且他们会将同样的50%风险传给他们的每一个孩子。

sentences.en: I had a four-year-old and a two-year-old at that time,
sentences.zh: 那时我有一个四岁的和一个两岁的孩子，

sentences.en: Barb's hold me.
sentences.zh: 芭芭拉告诉我。

sentences.en: And I remember thinking, I shouldn't have had my kids.
sentences.zh: 我记得当时想，我不该生孩子的。

sentences.en: She stopped short as she recalled this, then collected herself.
sentences.zh: 她回忆到这里时停顿了一下，然后平复了心情。

sentences.en: Which is like a very hard thing for a parent to think.
sentences.zh: 对一个父母来说，这真的是一件很难去想的事情。

sentences.en: It's a devastating feeling that I may have passed something to them that could hurt them.
sentences.zh: 那种感觉太毁灭了：我可能把某种会伤害他们的东西传给了他们。

sentences.en: Even now, many in the family struggle with how to explain the impossible situation they've found themselves in.
sentences.zh: 甚至现在，家族中的许多人仍在挣扎，不知该如何解释他们所陷入的这种无可奈何的境地。

sentences.en: An earthquake or hurricane or war comes close.
sentences.zh: 地震、飓风或战争勉强算得上相似。

sentences.en: Only a strange science fiction version.
sentences.zh: 只有科幻小说里离奇的版本才配得上。

sentences.en: Something not visible or experienced by anyone but them.
sentences.zh: 某种除了他们之外谁也看不见、体验不到的东西。

sentences.en: A disaster existing only inside their family's genetic code.
sentences.zh: 一场只存在于他们家族基因密码内部的灾难。

sentences.en: There were the facts.
sentences.zh: 事实就是如此。

sentences.en: It's inherited.
sentences.zh: 这是遗传的。

sentences.en: Anyone might have it.
sentences.zh: 任何人都有可能患上。

sentences.en: And there were the deeper questions raised by those facts.
sentences.zh: 而这些事实也引发了更深层次的问题。

sentences.en: How do you feel safe, knowing that it is in your family's essential nature to be fragile, ephemeral, ever close to expiration?
sentences.zh: 当你明知家族的本质就是脆弱、短暂、随时濒临崩溃时，你要如何才能感到安全？

sentences.en: How do you keep living when you know that everything that makes you a conscious person could disappear?
sentences.zh: 当你明知造就你作为一个有意识之人的所有一切都可能消失时，你该如何继续生活？

sentences.en: If you were going to lose yourself in a year or two or ten, would you even want to know?
sentences.zh: 如果你在一两年或十年内就会迷失自我，你甚至还想知道吗？

sentences.en: Once the researchers found the mutation, they encouraged each family member to test at an independent lab to learn who carried it.
sentences.zh: 一旦研究人员发现了突变，他们就会鼓励每个家庭成员去独立实验室进行检测，以了解谁是携带者。

sentences.en: Everyone in the family could discover which side of the coin flip they landed.
sentences.zh: 家族中的每个人都可以查清自己落在了掷硬币的哪一面。

sentences.en: But not everyone did.
sentences.zh: 但并非所有人都去了。

sentences.en: Teddy said he was never going back to the Mayo Clinic again.
sentences.zh: 泰迪说他再也不会去梅奥诊所了。

sentences.en: And he hasn't.
sentences.zh: 他也确实没再去过。

sentences.en: Even Barb, who had been cajoling the others to get tested, could not bring herself to do so.
sentences.zh: 就连一直劝说其他人去检测的芭芭拉，自己也过不了心里那一关。

sentences.en: Her future seemed like a forked road with no good options.
sentences.zh: 她的未来看起来就像一条没有好选择的分叉路口。

sentences.en: Turn one way, you become essentially a shadow version of yourself, and everyone you love has to spend their lives taking care of you.
sentences.zh: 走这条路，你基本上成了自己的影子版本，而你爱的人不得不花一辈子照顾你。

sentences.en: Turn the other, and you still have to say goodbye, slowly, to some of the people you love the moSt.
sentences.zh: 走另一条路，你仍然不得不慢慢地跟一些你最爱的人告别。

sentences.en: Why not do whatever you could not to engage in that strange binary choice?
sentences.zh: 为什么不尽一切努力不去涉足那种奇怪的二选一呢？

sentences.en: And so Barb decided not to decide.
sentences.zh: 于是芭芭拉决定不做决定。

sentences.en: She was 32 when the family learned about the mutation in 2008.
sentences.zh: 2008年家族得知这种突变时，她才32岁。

sentences.en: Even if she did have FTD, she most likely would not present symptoms for at least a decade.
sentences.zh: 即使她真的患有FTD，她很可能在至少十年内都不会表现出症状。

sentences.en: She would give herself until her early 40s to take action.
sentences.zh: 她决定给自己留出时间，到40岁出头再采取行动。

sentences.en: I figured, okay,
sentences.zh: 我想，好吧，

sentences.en: I've got maybe
sentences.zh: 我大概还剩下

sentences.en: 10 good years left, she said.
sentences.zh: 10年的好时光，她说。

sentences.en: Others in the family would take priority for now.
sentences.zh: 家族里的其他人现在应该优先考虑。

sentences.en: The siblings I was closest with, they all raised me practically, so my immediate concern was for them.
sentences.zh: 跟我最亲近的兄弟姐妹，几乎都是他们把我带大的，所以我最关心的是他们。

sentences.en: Just, you know, how many more people am I going to lose from this disease in the next few years?
sentences.zh: 只是，你知道的，在接下来的几年里，我还要因这种疾病失去多少人？

sentences.en: As long as Barb didn't know if she had it, she would try to live as if she didn't.
sentences.zh: 只要芭芭拉不知道自己有没有得病，她就会尽量当作自己没得病一样生活。

sentences.en: This was especially important to her because she spent her childhood watching her mother decline and then die.
sentences.zh: 这对她来说尤其重要，因为她的童年就是在眼睁睁看着母亲病情恶化然后离世中度过的。

sentences.en: I know that I did not grow up with a normal childhood,
sentences.zh: 我知道我度过的不是一个正常的童年，

sentences.en: Barb said.
sentences.zh: 芭芭拉说。

sentences.en: I wanted to give my kids as normal a childhood as possible.
sentences.zh: 我想给我的孩子们一个尽可能正常的童年。

sentences.en: If I knew I was destined to get this horrible disease, how normal would it have been?
sentences.zh: 如果我知道自己注定要得这种可怕的疾病，那又会有多正常呢？

sentences.en: Of course, not being tested wasn't the same as not having the disease.
sentences.zh: 当然，不去做检测并不等于没有生病。

sentences.en: How could it be?
sentences.zh: 怎么可能呢？

sentences.en: Barb entered a limbo, uncertainty hovering over her.
sentences.zh: 芭芭拉陷入了一种无所适从的境地，不确定感挥之不去。

sentences.en: Waking life became a continuous test of cognition, one chance after another to wonder if she was losing it.
sentences.zh: 清醒的生活变成了一场对认知的持续测试，一个又一个瞬间让她忍不住怀疑自己是不是在失去理智。

sentences.en: Literally everything in a given day that goes wrong, if you forget someone's name or you lose your keys or you do something embarrassing, your mind instantly goes to, this is it,
sentences.zh: 字面意思上，在任何一天里只要有任何不顺，如果你忘了某个人的名字，或者丢了钥匙，或者做了什么尴尬的事，你的脑子里立刻就会蹦出：就是这个，

sentences.en: this is the beginning, it's starting.
sentences.zh: 这就是开始，它发作了。

sentences.en: It just totally messes with you.
sentences.zh: 这简直把你的心态彻底搞崩了。

sentences.en: It's exhausting.
sentences.zh: 这太让人筋疲力尽了。

sentences.en: She was vigilant in policing those thoughts, trying to keep the worst ones at bay, even shielding her husband.
sentences.zh: 她时刻警惕着控制这些想法，试图把最糟糕的想法挡在脑海外面，甚至还要护着她的丈夫。

sentences.en: He told me in a highly convincing way that no matter what happens to me, he's going to be with me until the end, she said.
sentences.zh: 她回忆说，他非常坚定地对我说，无论我发生什么事，他都会陪我走到最后。

sentences.en: But you know, there were a lot of times where I was dealing with that emotional stress alone because I didn't want to burden him with it.
sentences.zh: 但你知道的，很多时候我都是一个人在承受那种情绪压力，因为我不想给他添负担。

sentences.en: Her husband, meanwhile, took action of his own, changing careers, training to be a lawyer to ensure he would make enough to support them.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，她的丈夫采取了自己的行动：他改变了职业，接受法律培训，以确保自己能赚到足够的钱来养家糊口。

sentences.en: Only years later would they talk explicitly about what he had done.
sentences.zh: 直到多年后，他们才明确地谈起他所做过的事。

sentences.en: It was a huge sacrifice that he made,
sentences.zh: 那是他做出的一大牺牲，

sentences.en: Barb said.
sentences.zh: 芭芭拉说。

sentences.en: As time went on and the pretense of normalcy became harder to maintain,
sentences.zh: 随着时间推移，维持正常生活的伪装变得越来越难，

sentences.en: Barb still tried to keep her children from hearing about FTD, even though they, like her, might possibly have the mutation, and even though it would be impossible
sentences.zh: 芭芭拉仍然试图不让孩子们听到关于FTD的事，尽管他们和她一样有可能携带这种突变，而且随着他们长大，

sentences.en: to keep that information from them as they grew older.
sentences.zh: 要对他们隐瞒这些信息是不可能的。

sentences.en: She also followed new research on FTD and Alzheimer's, two distinct diseases, each incurable, that attack brain function but with remarkably different genetic properties,
sentences.zh: 她还关注着关于FTD和阿尔茨海默病的新研究——这两种截然不同的疾病都无法治愈，都会攻击大脑功能，但其基因特性却有着显著的不同——

sentences.en: and fell into despair as no treatments for FTD emerged from that research.
sentences.zh: 并且随着那些研究没能涌现出任何针对FTD的疗法，她陷入了绝望。

sentences.en: Then, as Barb watched
sentences.zh: 然后，看着

sentences.en: Christy and Mary decline further and two more sisters learned they had the mutation,
sentences.zh: 克里斯蒂和玛丽的病情进一步恶化，又有两个姐姐——珍妮在2010年、

sentences.en: Jenny in 2010,
sentences.zh: 佩吉在2015年——得知自己带有这种突变，芭芭拉感到某种东西正在向她逼近，已经无法忽视。

sentences.en: Peggy in 2015, the sense that something was coming for her became impossible to ignore.
sentences.zh: 到2016年，随着她40岁生日的临近，

sentences.en: In 2016, with her 40th birthday closing in,
sentences.zh: 芭芭拉确信自己其实也已经中招了。

sentences.en: Barb became certain that she did, in fact, have it.
sentences.zh: 她开始做最坏的打算，过一天算一天。

sentences.en: She began bracing for the worst, living as if her days were numbered.
sentences.zh: 在梅奥诊所发布诊断结果八年之后，

sentences.en: Eight years after the Mayo Clinic issued its diagnosis,
sentences.zh: 芭芭拉终于去做了检测，去抽了那管将决定她余生走向的血。

sentences.en: Barb was tested, going in for the blood draw that would tell the story of the rest of her life.
sentences.zh: 临床医生要求患者必须亲自来听取无论好坏的结果。

sentences.en: The clinicians required patients to receive the news, good or bad, in person.
sentences.zh: 但芭芭拉从未回去听取结果。

sentences.en: But Barb never went back to hear the results.
sentences.zh: 我是刘玟。

sentences.en: I'm Wena Liu.
sentences.zh: 我制作了游戏

sentences.en: I write the game
sentences.zh: 《Connections》（《连线》），这是《纽约时报》游戏板块的谜题之一，我非常喜欢恐怖电影。

sentences.en: Connections, one of the puzzles from New York Times games, and I love horror movies.
sentences.zh: 我爱我的狗，我也喜欢试图捉弄你们。

sentences.en: I love my dog, and I love trying to trick you.
sentences.zh: 我是萨姆·马祖斯基，我每天负责制作

sentences.en: I'm Sam Mazursky, and I create the game

sentences.zh: 当母亲的病情变得无法忽视时，她才12岁；当时克里斯蒂不再洗澡、不再购物，也不再做饭。

sentences.en: C, was frightened, not least because of how alone she was.
sentences.zh: 她的父亲正和母亲闹离婚，已经搬到了隔壁镇上，而她的弟弟还不到八岁，太小了，还无法意识到某些在她看来

sentences.en: Her father was divorcing her mother and had moved to a neighboring town, and her brother was not yet eight, too young to register some of the things that she understood

sentences.en: to be obviously wrong.
sentences.zh: 直到现在，她仍然觉得很难谈论她生命中的那段时间。

sentences.en: Even now, she finds it hard to talk about that time in her life.
sentences.zh: 她告诉我，有一次开车带她回家时，车胎爆了，她却一直开着车，

sentences.zh: 我当时就说，

sentences.en: I was like,
sentences.zh: 妈，你知道的，你得把车停路边。

sentences.en: Mom, you know, you've got to pull over.
sentences.zh: 向父亲敲响警钟的重任落在了她肩上。

sentences.en: It was up to her to raise the alarm with her father.
sentences.zh: 我记得家里有个水管爆裂了，她却没有叫人来修。

sentences.en: I remember a pipe burst in our house, and she didn't get it repaired.
sentences.zh: 我们好几天都没水用。

sentences.en: The children moved in with him when she was 13, and Susan moved in with Christy.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，C的父亲一直在经济上支持对克里斯蒂的照顾。

sentences.en: C's father has helped financially support Christy's care ever since.
sentences.zh: 如今，

sentences.en: Today,
sentences.zh: C非常护着她的父亲。

sentences.en: C is protective of her father.
sentences.zh: 她说，他曾试图为她寻求帮助。

sentences.en: He tried to get her help, she said.
sentences.zh: 他曾联系过我的外公，也就是我妈妈的爸爸，说：克里斯蒂出问题了。

sentences.en: He had reached out to my grandfather, my mom's dad, and said, something's wrong with Christy.
sentences.zh: 有什么东西正在改变。

sentences.en: Something's changing.
sentences.zh: 而外公只是不以为然地把这事敷衍过去了。

sentences.en: And he just brushed it off.
sentences.zh: 她对自己的隐私也同样有着强烈的保护欲。

sentences.en: She is equally protective of her own privacy.
sentences.zh: 结束

sentences.en: She mentioned, and several others in the family told me this, that two of her aunts lost their jobs after speaking openly about their family's illness.
sentences.zh: 她提到，家族里的好几个人也告诉过她，她的两个姑姑在公开谈论家族的病情后失去了工作。

sentences.en: She is also charitable toward Christy.
sentences.zh: 她对克里斯蒂也十分宽容。

sentences.en: I do remember her being a wonderful person, just fun and active, she said.
sentences.zh: 她说，她确实记得克里斯蒂曾经是个极好的人，既有趣又充满活力。

sentences.en: But those happier memories seem less accessible to see now, overshadowed by everything that occurred after the disease took over.
sentences.zh: 但那些快乐的记忆现在似乎很难再现，全被疾病爆发后发生的一切阴霾所掩盖。

sentences.en: During her teenage years, she watched from a distance as her aunt Susan handled a host of challenges.
sentences.zh: 在她十几岁的时候，她在一旁看着苏珊姑姑应对各种各样的挑战。

sentences.en: Christy owed the IRS
sentences.zh: 克里斯蒂欠了国税局

sentences.en: $10,000 in back taxes.
sentences.zh: 1万美元的滞纳税款。

sentences.en: Christy ballooned to 250 pounds until Susan finally padlocked the refrigerator.
sentences.zh: 克里斯蒂的体重一度飙升到250磅，直到苏珊最后给冰箱加了锁。

sentences.en: Once,
sentences.zh: 有一次，

sentences.en: Christy bolted from the mall on a shopping trip and wandered five miles in the cold and rain to a Wendy's where the police were called and bought her dinner.
sentences.zh: 克里斯蒂在一次购物旅行中突然从商场跑开，在寒风冷雨中走了五英里，来到一家温蒂汉堡店，最后警察被叫来并给她买了一顿晚餐。

sentences.en: Susan was in tears when she caught up with her.
sentences.zh: 苏珊追上她时泪流满面。

sentences.en: But Christy was fine, unfazed, even cheerful.
sentences.zh: 但克里斯蒂却安然无恙，淡定自若，甚至还很高兴。

sentences.en: During C's visits, she could see for herself her mother's mysterious, almost random new personality.
sentences.zh: 在C拜访期间，她亲眼见到了母亲那种神秘的、几乎是随机出现的新人格。

sentences.en: Once, in front of C's boyfriend,
sentences.zh: 有一次，在C的男友面前，

sentences.en: Christy asked C whether she was sleeping with David Hasselhoff, the star of Baywatch,
sentences.zh: 克里斯蒂问C是否在和《海滩游侠》的主演大卫·哈塞尔霍夫睡觉，

sentences.en: Christy's favorite show at the time.
sentences.zh: 《海滩游侠》是当时克里斯蒂最喜欢的节目。

sentences.en: Watching her mother become so unrecognizable was excruciating.
sentences.zh: 看着母亲变得如此面目全非，令人痛苦万分。

sentences.en: But with Susan looking after Christy,
sentences.zh: 但有苏珊照顾克里斯蒂，

sentences.en: C was at least free to be a teenager, to go to school, to one day start a life of her own.
sentences.zh: C至少可以自由地做一个青少年，去上学，并终有一天开始属于自己的生活。

sentences.en: Once she was in her mid-twenties, building a career, that might have been that.
sentences.zh: 等她二十五岁左右、开始建立事业时，事情本该就此结束。

sentences.en: Her mother's tragic disease, a difficult childhood, a safe landing with her father.
sentences.zh: 母亲悲惨的疾病，艰难的童年，以及在父亲庇护下的安全港湾。

sentences.en: Then her family learned about FTD.
sentences.zh: 然后，她的家族得知了额颞叶痴呆（FTD）。

sentences.en: While others, particularly her older relatives, lined up for genetic tests, she, like Barb, froze in place, deciding that she didn't want to know.
sentences.zh: 当其他人——尤其是她年长的亲戚们——纷纷排队进行基因检测时，她和芭芭拉一样僵在了原地，决定自己不想知道。

sentences.en: She wanted to give herself time.
sentences.zh: 她想给自己留出一点时间。

sentences.en: I was just like, if I find out I have this right now,
sentences.zh: 她曾说：“我当时就想，如果我现在就查出自己有这个病，

sentences.en: I'm not going to have any motivation, she said.
sentences.zh: 我将不会有任何动力，

sentences.en: I'm not going to have any desire to move forward.
sentences.zh: 我将没有任何前进的欲望。”

sentences.en: She made a bargain with herself.
sentences.zh: 她与自己达成了一个协议。

sentences.en: She would be tested in five years, when she turned 30.
sentences.zh: 她将在五年后、也就是自己30岁时接受检测。

sentences.en: For her, the decision to delay knowing felt less like denial than a play for personal agency, for control over something she had no control over.
sentences.zh: 对她而言，推迟知晓结果的决定与其说是逃避，不如说是为了争取个人的自主权，为了对那些她无法掌控的事情保持一丝控制。

sentences.en: For those five years,
sentences.zh: 在那五年里，

sentences.en: C worked hard not to think about the family's condition, to move forward as if it wasn't there.
sentences.zh: C努力不去想家族的病情，像它根本不存在一样继续前行。

sentences.en: Pretending was even less possible for her than for Barb, when the example of her own mother was always present, directly in front of her, living with full-time care,
sentences.zh: 装作无事发生对她来说比对芭芭拉更不可能，因为她亲生母亲的例子就摆在眼前，活生生地需要全天候照护，

sentences.en: losing her ability to speak, losing herself.
sentences.zh: 正在失去说话的能力，正在失去自我。

sentences.en: When C turned 30, she had a boyfriend, a serious one, whom she told about the risk of FTD almost as soon as they started dating several years earlier.
sentences.zh: 当C满30岁时，她有一个交往认真的男友。在几年前刚开始约会时，她几乎是立刻就把患FTD的风险告诉了他。

sentences.en: Now they were engaged.
sentences.zh: 现在他们订婚了。

sentences.en: She went through with her plan to find out the truth.
sentences.zh: 她执行了去寻找真相的计划。

sentences.en: I wanted him to have the choice to opt out if he didn't want to deal with me, she said.
sentences.zh: 她说：“我希望如果他不想应对我这种情况，能有选择离开的权利。”

sentences.en: They were together when she learned the news.
sentences.zh: 得知消息时，他们正依偎在一起。

sentences.en: Her boyfriend held her hand, no words passing between them.
sentences.zh: 男友握着她的手，两人无言以对。

sentences.en: I remember even the genetic therapist saying, you guys are just like such a great couple.
sentences.zh: “我甚至记得连基因治疗师都说：‘你们俩真是一对绝配。'

sentences.en: I'm so sorry I have to tell you this.
sentences.zh: ‘非常抱歉我不得不告诉你们这个消息。’”

sentences.en: C approaches her life with a brass tacks practicality.
sentences.zh: C对待生活有一种务实落地的态度。

sentences.en: Others have it worse than me, as a frequent conversational landing place for her, as is, it is what it is.
sentences.zh: “比我惨的人多的是”成了她口头经常出现的总结，现状如此，既来之则安之。

sentences.en: After a childhood of instability and an adulthood of deep, pervasive uncertainty, she is determined not to waste energy on what she can't change or pull her focus away from a life
sentences.zh: 经历了不稳定的童年和深刻而弥漫的成年不确定性之后，她决心不把精力浪费在她无法改变的事情上，也不把注意力从她

sentences.en: she loves.
sentences.zh: 所热爱的生活中抽离。

sentences.en: She sees the world in this way, it seems, even if that means shaping complex situations in simpler terms, a sort of emotional firewall around the FTD diagnosis.
sentences.zh: 看来她就是这样看待世界的，即便这意味着用更简单的词汇来包装复杂的情况，在FTD诊断周围建立起某种情感防火墙。

sentences.en: Her husband has become a good partner in maintaining that firewall.
sentences.zh: 她的丈夫已经成为了维护那堵防火墙的好搭档。

sentences.en: They were married, as they had planned.
sentences.zh: 他们按照计划结了婚。

sentences.en: He had already seen my family, she said, smiling, so I guess he kind of knew what he was getting into.
sentences.zh: 她微笑着说：“他以前就已经见过我的家人了，所以我想他大概知道自己要面对的是什么。”

sentences.en: Together, they sorted through everything they could control.
sentences.zh: 他们一起梳理了所有他们能够控制的事情。

sentences.en: We talked about long-term care insurance and genetic testing for kids, she said, but I think we both understand that we can't control the FTD aspect of things.
sentences.zh: 她说道：“我们讨论了长期护理保险和孩子的基因检测，但我认为我们都明白，我们无法控制FTD这方面的因素。”

sentences.en: After the wedding, they took time off and traveled.
sentences.zh: 婚礼结束后，他们请假去旅游。

sentences.en: Better now than later, they thought.
sentences.zh: 他们想，及时行乐总好过以后。

sentences.en: Just as she embraced living with her father when being with Christy became impossible, so now, in the face of something extreme, she clung to what happiness she could find.
sentences.zh: 正如当年无法和克里斯蒂在一起时她选择投奔父亲一样，现在面对极端的情况，她也紧紧抓住她所能找到的每一丝幸福。

sentences.en: When she decided to start a family
sentences.zh: 当她决定组建家庭时，

sentences.en: available for not passing on FTD,
sentences.zh: 有一种方法可以避免将FTD遗传下去，

sentences.en: selective embryo transfer.
sentences.zh: 那就是选择性胚胎移植。

sentences.en: C could have her embryos frozen, and doctors could implant only the ones that did not have the mutation.
sentences.zh: C可以冷冻她的胚胎，医生只将没有这种突变的胚胎植入体内。

sentences.en: More than a year of arduous procedures followed.
sentences.zh: 接下来是一年多艰苦卓绝的程序。

sentences.en: Fertility treatments and embryo retrieval followed by four attempts to implant, none of them successful.
sentences.zh: 生育治疗和胚胎取卵，接着进行了四次胚胎植入尝试，但无一成功。

sentences.en: My body did not like frozen embryos,
sentences.zh: C说：

sentences.en: C said.
sentences.zh: “我的身体排斥冷冻胚胎。”

sentences.en: She was readying herself for another retrieval and a fifth implantation when she found she'd become pregnant naturally.
sentences.zh: 正当她准备进行又一次取卵和第五次植入时，她发现自己自然怀孕了。

sentences.en: This, she told me, wasn't planned.
sentences.zh: 她告诉我，这并非计划之中。

sentences.en: Though given the difficulty they were having in conceiving, they weren't inclined to be vigilant about birth control.
sentences.zh: 不过鉴于他们在受孕方面遇到了重重困难，他们也并没有刻意去严格避孕。

sentences.en: She chuckled dryly when she told the story.
sentences.zh: 讲到这个故事时，她发出了一声干笑。

sentences.en: A life filled with unexpected twists gets one more.
sentences.zh: 充满意外转折的人生又迎来了一个新转折。

sentences.en: She and her husband had all the obvious worries about the family mutation, but by then they had plenty of practice playing through those fears.
sentences.zh: 她和丈夫对家族突变有着所有显而易见的担忧，但到那时，他们已经有了丰富的演练经验来应对这些恐惧。

sentences.en: Instead of fixating on what their child might inherit,
sentences.zh: C没有过分纠结于他们的孩子可能会遗传到什么，

sentences.en: C thought about the clock ticking in more ways than one.
sentences.zh: 而是觉得生命的倒计时在以更多的方式滴答作响。

sentences.en: She was 36, and after four attempts, it felt a little like now or never.
sentences.zh: 她已经36岁了，经历了四次失败后，这感觉有点像机不可失，时不再来。

sentences.en: With everything she had lived through and everything that was coming, she believed that good fortune was too precious to turn her back on.
sentences.zh: 凭借她所经历的一切以及未来将要面对的一切，她坚信这份好运太过珍贵，不容拒绝。

sentences.en: Who's to say what other parents may be passing along to their children?
sentences.zh: 谁又能说其他父母没有将什么东西遗传给他们的孩子呢？

sentences.en: Genetic risks they don't know about and that no one can test for.
sentences.zh: 那些他们不知道、且无人能检测出来的基因风险。

sentences.en: And more broadly, isn't she allowed to want this for herself?
sentences.zh: 从更广泛的意义上讲，难道她就不能为自己渴望这一点吗？

sentences.en: Doesn't everyone have the right to a family?
sentences.zh: 难道每个人不都拥有拥有家庭的权利吗？

sentences.en: Her aunts, uncles, and cousins all had to be wondering about the genetic implications of having children.
sentences.zh: 她的姑姑、叔叔和表亲们肯定都思考过生育后代的基因影响。

sentences.en: But the mutation casts a shadow over every interaction.
sentences.zh: 但这种基因突变给每一次互动都投下了阴影。

sentences.en: Those who have it are too preoccupied to question the choices of others, and those who don't feel too guilty to second-guess those who do.
sentences.zh: 携带者们自顾不暇，无暇去质疑他人的选择，而未携带者则心怀内疚，不敢对他人评头论足。

sentences.en: Barb, for one, has never broached the subject with C.
sentences.zh: 就拿芭芭拉来说，她从未向C提起过这个话题。

sentences.en: This disease brings up so many moral and ethical questions,
sentences.zh: 芭芭拉告诉我说：

sentences.en: Barb told me.
sentences.zh: “这种疾病引发了太多的道德和伦理问题。”

sentences.en: I think all of us have tried to refrain from judging.
sentences.zh: “我想我们所有人都尽量克制自己不去评判。”

sentences.en: C now lives with her husband and son in a town not unlike where she grew up, where Christy raised her until she couldn't.
sentences.zh: C现在和丈夫及儿子住在距离她成长地不远的一个小镇里，克里斯蒂就是在这里抚养她长大，直到无力抚养为止。

sentences.en: She is 40, about the same age her mother was when she first started showing symptoMs.
sentences.zh: 她今年40岁，这大约是她母亲开始出现症状时的年龄。

sentences.en: She sees Christy on holidays, visiting her and
sentences.zh: 她在节假日里去看望克里斯蒂，并拜访

sentences.en: Susan in Pittsburgh.
sentences.zh: 匹兹堡的苏珊。

sentences.en: The rest of her time is spent trying to have a life of her own.
sentences.zh: 她其余的时间都用来努力过好自己的生活。

sentences.en: Her career is exciting, filled with problem-solving.
sentences.zh: 她的职业生涯令人兴奋，充满了解决问题的挑战。

sentences.en: Every day at her job is different and distractions abound.
sentences.zh: 她工作的每一天都各不相同，各种琐事纷至沓来。

sentences.en: Once a year, along with many other members of her family, she goes in for testing to chart the progress of the mutation's effects.
sentences.zh: 每年一次，她会和许多家族成员一起去接受检测，以绘制基因突变影响的发展图表。

sentences.en: MRIs, blood tests, neurological exams, cognitive tests, behavioral tests, a lumbar puncture for brain fluid.
sentences.zh: 核磁共振、血液检查、神经学检查、认知测试、行为测试，还有抽取脑脊液的腰椎穿刺。

sentences.en: Recently, her doctor asked about her performance reviews at work.
sentences.zh: 最近，医生询问了她在工作中的绩效考核情况。

sentences.en: I said, well,
sentences.zh: 我说，嗯，

sentences.en: I'm not trying to brag or anything, but they're always really good.
sentences.zh: 我倒不是想吹牛什么的，但我的考核结果一直都非常好。

sentences.en: The doctor's reply was sobering.
sentences.zh: 医生的回答却十分清醒而严峻。

sentences.en: That's the first thing that's going to be a sign that you're getting it.
sentences.zh: “那将是你开始发病的第一个信号。”

sentences.en: She nodded.
sentences.zh: 她点了点头。

sentences.en: One more benchmark to consider, both useful and terrifying.
sentences.zh: 又多了一个需要权衡的基准，既有用又可怕。

sentences.en: They have not tested their son for the mutation.
sentences.zh: 他们没有为儿子做基因突变检测。

sentences.en: That,
sentences.zh: C斩钉截铁地告诉我说：

sentences.zh: “那将由他自己决定。”

sentences.en: He'll learn eventually that there's a possibility, she said.
sentences.zh: 她说道：“他最终会知道存在这种可能性的。”

sentences.en: I'm not going to ruin his life, you know, worrying about this.
sentences.zh: “你知道的，我不会为了担心这个而毁了他的生活。”

sentences.en: And if her son is diagnosed one day, it's easy for her to daydream about new genetic editing techniques like CRISPR, swooping in to save him with one simple, graceful,
sentences.zh: 如果有一天她的儿子被诊断患病，她很容易会畅想基因编辑新技术（如CRISPR）的介入，通过一次简单、优雅、

sentences.en: elegant snip, deleting the problematic mutation from his DNA.
sentences.zh: 精妙的剪切来拯救他，抹去他DNA中带问题的突变。

sentences.en: No cure is imminent.
sentences.zh: 短期内不会有治愈的希望。

sentences.en: But that can always change,
sentences.zh: 但情况随时可能改变，

sentences.en: C tells herself.
sentences.zh: C心里这么告诉自己。

sentences.en: I think that in the next
sentences.zh: 她说道：“我认为在接下来的

sentences.en: 40 years, there's going to be a lot of movement on this stuff, she said.
sentences.zh: 40年里，这方面会有很大的进展。”

sentences.en: I think he has a better chance than I do, and definitely more than my mom did.
sentences.zh: “我认为他的机会比我大，绝对比我妈妈当年要大。”

sentences.en: Of course, it's probable that her son will be there to observe her changes, just as she observed her mother's.
sentences.zh: 当然，她的儿子很可能会亲眼目睹她的病情变化，正如她当年目睹母亲的变化一样。

sentences.en: She and her husband have made arrangements with her father's help for any long-term care she'll need.
sentences.zh: 她和丈夫在父亲的帮助下，已经为她未来可能需要的长期护理做好了安排。

sentences.en: Her genetic mutation clearly dictates certain things about her life, but she maintains she still has choices.
sentences.zh: 她的基因突变显然决定了她人生的某些方面，但她坚称自己依然拥有选择权。

sentences.en: Her choice is to decide, to insist, that her reality is not so different from others.
sentences.zh: 她的选择是去认定并坚持认为，她的现实与其他人并没有什么不同。

sentences.en: Even though I didn't really have a mom, you know, I love my husband,
sentences.zh: C说：“尽管我其实并没有真正拥有过一个妈妈，你知道的，但我爱我的丈夫，

sentences.en: C said.
sentences.zh: 我爱我的孩子，

sentences.en: I love my child.
sentences.zh: 我爱我的狗，

sentences.en: I love my dog.
sentences.zh: 我爱我的事业，

sentences.en: I love my career.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我爱我的朋友，

sentences.en: You know, I love my friends.
sentences.zh: 我爱我的家人。

sentences.en: I love my family.
sentences.zh: 难道我要把注意力都放在那些糟糕的事情上吗？”

sentences.en: Am I going to focus on things that are bad?
sentences.zh: 她一直在说，我们谁也不知道我们的故事会以何种方式收场，也不知道终点到来时我们会呈现出什么样的状态。

sentences.en: None of us know how our stories will end, she was saying, or what shape we'll be in by the time the end comes.
sentences.zh: “我想我从小到大一直对自我灌输的另一件事是，每个人在生活中注定都要应对一定分量的磨难，而我是把磨难提前了，

sentences.en: I guess another thing that I always kind of told myself growing up was that everyone is given a certain amount to deal with in life, and I'm dealing with it early,
sentences.zh: 所以我的后半生将会无比美好。”

sentences.en: so the rest of my life is going to be great.
sentences.zh: 芭芭拉曾向她警告过她的姐姐珍妮，说她还没有接受现实。

sentences.en: Barb had warned me about her sister, Jenny, that she hadn't accepted reality.
sentences.zh: 她说：“她觉得一切都好得很。”

sentences.en: She thinks everything's just fine, she said.
sentences.zh: 珍妮是第八个孩子，也是在年龄上与芭芭拉最亲近的姐姐，仅大她十岁。

sentences.en: Jenny is the eighth child, the sister closest in age to Barb, just ten years older.
sentences.zh: 多年来，她一直是财富世界500强企业的高管。

sentences.en: For many years, she was an executive with a Fortune 500 company.
sentences.zh: 她和从事金融工作的丈夫

sentences.en: She and her husband,
sentences.zh: 比尔住在纽约郊外的一个小镇里，并在那里抚养了两个孩子。

sentences.en: Bill, who works in finance, lived in a town outside New York where they raised two children.
sentences.zh: 当克里斯蒂的生活在1995年开始崩塌时，

sentences.en: When Christy's life started to fall apart in 1995,
sentences.zh: 珍妮是第一个赶到现场的人，她帮克里斯蒂打扫房屋并寻找神经科医生。

sentences.en: Jenny was the first one there, cleaning Christy's house and finding a neurologiSt.
sentences.zh: 然后在2010年，在她43岁时，

sentences.en: Then in 2010, at 43,
sentences.zh: 珍妮得知自己也携带了这种突变基因。

sentences.en: Jenny learned she carried the mutation too.
sentences.zh: 她继续生活，仿佛什么都没有改变。

sentences.en: She went on with life as if nothing had changed.
sentences.zh: 她没有把自己的诊断结果告诉还年幼的孩子们。

sentences.en: She did not disclose her diagnosis to her children who were still young.
sentences.zh: 她告诉一些亲戚说她要与病魔抗争，坚信改变生活方式就能遏制症状并拯救自己免于宿命。

sentences.en: She told some relatives she was going to fight it, believing that changes to her lifestyle would stave off symptoms and save her from the inevitable.
sentences.zh: 她宣称科学家们离找到治愈方法已经不远了，尽管事实上并没有这样的曙光，这让身边的一些人开始琢磨

sentences.en: Scientists were close to a cure, she declared, though there was, in fact, no such thing on the horizon, which made some in her orbit wonder how far gone
sentences.zh: 珍妮的病情到底已经发展到了什么地步。

sentences.en: Jenny already was.
sentences.zh: 但她太决心保持自我了，以至于把自己的诊断结果告诉了同事，并在那之后不久失去了工作。

sentences.en: But she was so determined to remain herself that she told her co-workers about her diagnosis and lost her job soon after that.
sentences.zh: 从那以后她再也没有过全职工作。

sentences.en: She hasn't been employed full-time since then.
sentences.zh: 珍妮和比尔住在一条长满林木的街道尽头的一栋宽敞住宅里。

sentences.en: Jenny and Bill live in a sprawling home at the end of a long wooded street.
sentences.zh: 在吃午饭时，坐在比尔身边的

sentences.en: Over lunch, sitting next to Bill,
sentences.zh: 珍妮起初阳光灿烂、开朗健谈。

sentences.en: Jenny was sunny and bright and chatty at firSt.
sentences.zh: 她很乐意谈论FTD、她的兄弟姐妹以及基因突变，但似乎并不担心这种疾病对她自己生活的影响。

sentences.en: She was happy to talk about FTD, about her siblings, and about the mutation, but seemed unconcerned about the impact of the disease on her own life.
sentences.zh: 她说：“我觉得所有人都尽量克制自己不去评判。”

sentences.en: She had successfully adjusted her eating habits, she explained, to avoid getting FTD.
sentences.zh: 她解释说，为了避免患上额颞叶痴呆（FTD），她成功调整了自己的饮食习惯。

sentences.en: She was proud of the years she spent volunteering with an FTD organization, counseling family members of others who had been diagnosed.
sentences.zh: 她为自己在一家FTD组织做志愿者的那些年感到自豪，当时她为其他确诊患者的家属提供咨询。

sentences.en: I used to be the regional manager for this area, basically the northeast, she said, but then they switched it over to somebody else.
sentences.zh: 她说，我曾是这个地区的区域经理，基本上是东北地区，但后来他们把这个职位换给了别人。

sentences.en: Before long, I noticed that Jenny was repeating a lot of phrases.
sentences.zh: 没过多久，我注意到珍妮一直在重复很多短语。

sentences.en: Whenever a sibling had FTD, they were out of their mind, like her sister Peggy, a former school teacher who used to play fiddle in an Irish music ensemble and solve complicated
sentences.zh: 每当有兄弟姐妹患上FTD时，他们就会失去理智，就像她的姐姐佩吉一样，佩吉以前是一名学校老师，曾在爱尔兰音乐乐团里拉小提琴，还能解出复杂的

sentences.en: mathematical equations.
sentences.zh: 数学方程式。

sentences.en: Now Peggy doesn't cook or drive, and lives under the care of her longtime boyfriend.
sentences.zh: 现在佩吉不会做饭，也不会开车，在长期交往的男友的照顾下生活。

sentences.en: Jenny has often felt competitive with Peggy, and when she talks about her and some of the others, it is with an air of triumph.
sentences.zh: 珍妮常常对佩吉产生竞争心理，当她谈到佩吉和其他一些人时，语气中流露出一丝得意。

sentences.en: I was the one who figured out that Mary had it, and I was the one who figured out that Peggy had it,
sentences.zh: 是我发现玛丽得了这个病，也是我发现佩吉得了这个病，

sentences.en: Jenny said.
sentences.zh: 珍妮说道。

sentences.en: I could see their change in behavior.
sentences.zh: 我能看出他们行为上的变化。

sentences.en: I asked Jenny and Bill if they thought Jenny was fired in 2010 because of FTD.
sentences.zh: 我问珍妮和比尔，他们是否认为珍妮在2010年被解雇是因为患有FTD。

sentences.en: I think so, said Bill, thin and mild with a soft voice.
sentences.zh: 我想是的，比尔说，他身材瘦弱、温和，声音很轻。

sentences.en: Jenny interjected.
sentences.zh: 珍妮插话道。

sentences.en: I don't think so.
sentences.zh: 我不这么认为。

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 没有。

sentences.en: No, I was really good at my job.
sentences.zh: 不，我工作真的很出色。

sentences.en: No, you were,
sentences.zh: 不，你确实很出色，

sentences.en: Bill said.
sentences.zh: 比尔说。

sentences.en: He sounded tentative, not sure of how to frame what he was going to say next.
sentences.zh: 他的语气显得有些迟疑，似乎不知道接下来该如何组织语言。

sentences.en: But you know, they had this potential of your not doing well further on down the road.
sentences.zh: 但你知道，他们觉得你以后可能会表现不好。

sentences.en: But I still don't have the disease,
sentences.zh: 但我还是没有得这个病，

sentences.en: Jenny said flatly.
sentences.zh: 珍妮生硬地说。

sentences.en: Bill winced, and Jenny turned to me, smiled and shrugged, as if to say, case closed.
sentences.zh: 比尔畏缩了一下，珍妮转向我，微笑着耸了耸肩，仿佛在说，水落石出。

sentences.en: So, yeah.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的。

sentences.en: Over time, as we spoke,
sentences.zh: 随着时间的推移，在我们的交谈中，

sentences.en: Jenny's answers grew shorter, as if nothing we said was jogging new thoughts or leading her on new tangents.
sentences.zh: 珍妮的回答越来越简短，就好像我们说的任何话都无法唤起她的新想法，或是把她带向新的话题。

sentences.en: Even her gleaming smile started to strike me as limiting.
sentences.zh: 甚至她那灿烂的笑容也开始让我觉得有些局限。

sentences.en: Not an armor, exactly, but a reflex, a placeholder for more complicated emotions.
sentences.zh: 倒也不完全是防御，而更像是一种应激反应，一种掩饰更复杂情绪的代用品。

sentences.en: There seemed to be little behind it but a dwindling tank of memories.
sentences.zh: 在这笑容背后，似乎只剩下一个日渐枯竭的记忆库。

sentences.en: But Jenny maintained she was fine.
sentences.zh: 但珍妮坚称自己很好。

sentences.en: I'm a super deep sleeper, she told me.
sentences.zh: 她告诉我，我是一个睡眠极深的人。

sentences.en: What that does is it reduces inflammation of the brain.
sentences.zh: 这样做的好处是它可以减少大脑的炎症。

sentences.en: It completely reduces the inflammation of the brain, and so it keeps your brain really healthy.
sentences.zh: 它能完全减少大脑的炎症，从而让你的大脑保持非常健康。

sentences.en: She said she had proof.
sentences.zh: 她说她有证据。

sentences.en: Each year, she's evaluated by the same specialists,
sentences.zh: 每年，她都要接受同一位专家的评估，

sentences.en: Christy and C.
sentences.zh: 克里斯蒂和C

sentences.en: C.
sentences.zh: C。

sentences.en: Jenny proudly showed me a printout of her latest cognition test report.
sentences.zh: 珍妮自豪地向我展示了她最新认知测试报告的打印件。

sentences.en: Bill seemed interested in the printout, too.
sentences.zh: 比尔似乎对这份打印件也很感兴趣。

sentences.en: I looked at the paper and saw several categories with the word decline.
sentences.zh: 我看着那张纸，看到几个类别上写着“衰退”这个词。

sentences.en: When I pointed them out,
sentences.zh: 当我指出来时，

sentences.en: Jenny just smiled and shrugged.
sentences.zh: 珍妮只是笑了笑，耸了耸肩。

sentences.en: It's not really in decline, she told me.
sentences.zh: 她告诉我，这其实并不是在衰退。

sentences.en: It's just like my brain will play a game with me, and it, like, blocks memories sometimes.
sentences.zh: 就像我的大脑会和我玩游戏一样，有时候它会像这样屏蔽掉一些记忆。

sentences.en: I thought about Christy, how for so long she has seemed unaware of her condition, and how that is in some ways a blessing.
sentences.zh: 我想到了克里斯蒂，她很长一段时间以来似乎都不知道自己的病情，这在某种程度上其实也是一种福气。

sentences.en: Not realizing that dementia is creeping into your life is not the worst thing in the world.
sentences.zh: 没有意识到痴呆症正在悄然侵入你的生活，并不是世界上最糟糕的事情。

sentences.en: But for the people who love you, it can be not only horrifying, but depleting, both watching a tragedy and understanding how powerless you are to stop it.
sentences.zh: 但对爱你的人来说，这不仅令人感到恐怖，而且会榨干他们的精力，因为他们既在目睹一场悲剧，又明白自己对阻止这一切是多么无能为力。

sentences.en: Bill is at the precipice that the family crossed with Christy a long time ago.
sentences.zh: 比尔正站在悬崖边上，而这个家庭很久以前就已经和克里斯蒂一起跨过了这条线。

sentences.en: He struggles to find a gentle way to help Jenny, to correct her without seeming overbearing or otherwise outing himself as the caretaker he has clearly become.
sentences.zh: 他努力寻找一种温和的方式来帮助珍妮，在纠正她时又不会显得专横，或者不会无意中暴露出自己显然已经成了照顾者的事实。

sentences.en: But he knows that this is only going in one direction.
sentences.zh: 但他知道，这种情况只会朝着一个方向发展。

sentences.en: Even if he did come clean about the progress of her disease, he wonders what would change.
sentences.zh: 即使他真的坦白了她病情的进展，他也在琢磨会有什么改变。

sentences.en: If she understands that something is a symptom, will it become less of an issue?
sentences.zh: 如果她明白某种表现是一个症状，这个问题就会变得不那么严重吗？

sentences.en: Bill said to me later when we were alone,
sentences.zh: 后来当我们独处时，比尔对我说，

sentences.en: I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我不知道。

sentences.en: Jenny and Bill's daughter Annika uses a Benjamin Button analogy when she thinks about FTD.
sentences.zh: 珍妮和比尔的女儿安妮卡在想到FTD时，用了一个本杰明·巴顿式的比喻。

sentences.en: Whoever has it is aging backward, becoming not just dependent, but transformed.
sentences.zh: 患病的人正在逆向变老，不仅变得依赖他人，而且整个人都变了。

sentences.en: Jenny had been a workaholic, competitive, and hard driving.
sentences.zh: 珍妮曾是个工作狂，争强好胜，且充满冲劲。

sentences.en: After her diagnosis, she grew impulsive, just like the others.
sentences.zh: 确诊后，她变得容易冲动，就像其他人一样。

sentences.en: She was drinking,
sentences.zh: 她在喝酒，

sentences.en: Annika said.
sentences.zh: 安妮卡说。

sentences.en: It wasn't like she was an addict.
sentences.zh: 她倒不是成瘾了。

sentences.en: It's like she just wanted to do it to have fun, and she wanted to be sneaky about it.
sentences.zh: 就好像她只是为了好玩才想这么做，而且还想偷偷摸摸地进行。

sentences.en: She was acting like a teenager.
sentences.zh: 她表现得就像个十几岁的青少年。

sentences.en: Now, Annika says, her mother is consistently cheerful.
sentences.zh: 安妮卡说，现在她的母亲总是高高兴兴的。

sentences.en: Everything will be fine is Jenny's default position.
sentences.zh: “一切都会好的”是珍妮的口头禅。

sentences.en: She spends most days watching TV and shopping for food, visiting a number of different markets for exactly what she wants.
sentences.zh: 她大部分时间都在看电视、买食品，为了买到自己想要的东西会去好几家不同的市场。

sentences.en: Anything more complex than that seems beyond her.
sentences.zh: 任何比这更复杂的事情对她来说似乎都力所不及。

sentences.en: Annika is in her mid-twenties and living in another city, starting her life.
sentences.zh: 安妮卡二十多岁，住在另一个城市，开始了自己的生活。

sentences.en: She worries not just about her mother, but also her father, who has health issues of his own.
sentences.zh: 她不仅担心母亲，也担心身体本身就有毛病的父亲。

sentences.en: Who will care for her parents if he declines?
sentences.zh: 如果父亲的身体也垮了，谁来照顾她的父母？

sentences.en: That question helps
sentences.zh: 这个问题帮

sentences.en: Annika put off, for now, the decision she will have to face about herself.
sentences.zh: 安妮卡暂时搁置了她将来不得不面对的关于她自己的决定。

sentences.en: When to find out if she, too, carries the mutation.
sentences.zh: 那就是何时去查明自己是否也携带了这种突变基因。

sentences.en: Like Barb, she wants to put off reckoning with her fate in the name of preserving something supposedly more normal.
sentences.zh: 就像巴布一样，为了维持某种所谓更正常的生活状态，她想推迟面对自己的命运。

sentences.en: A few months after my visit, the family made some big decisions.
sentences.zh: 在我拜访几个月后，这个家庭做出了一些重大决定。

sentences.en: Bill and the children decided that Jenny couldn't be home alone anymore.
sentences.zh: 比尔和孩子们决定，珍妮不能再一个人在家了。

sentences.en: With Bill having to work at the office some days, he wants to hire an aide to watch Jenny.
sentences.zh: 由于比尔有时必须去办公室上班，他想雇一个护理员来照看珍妮。

sentences.en: He made plans to put the house in a trust and give the kids power of attorney over his health and finances.
sentences.zh: 他计划将房子放入信托基金，并让孩子们获得他的健康和财务代理权。

sentences.en: He's looking into taking Jenny to get her driving evaluated, with the hope that someone with the authority to tell her she can't drive will be enough to get her to stop.
sentences.zh: 他正考虑带珍妮去接受驾驶评估，希望由一个有权威告诉她不能开车的人来阻止她，这就足够让她停下来了。

sentences.en: Jenny has changed in the past months, too.
sentences.zh: 这几个月来，珍妮也变了。

sentences.en: She doesn't get upset or angry.
sentences.zh: 她不再心烦意乱或生气。

sentences.en: She's just, you know, communicating less,
sentences.zh: 比尔说，她只是，你知道的，交流变少了，

sentences.en: Bill said.
sentences.zh: 比尔说。

sentences.en: Often, she just doesn't respond at all.
sentences.zh: 通常，她根本不作回应。

sentences.en: Still, Jenny doesn't believe she needs an aide, and it's hard to say how well she will listen to one.
sentences.zh: 尽管如此，珍妮还是认为自己不需要护理员，而且很难说她会有多听护理员的话。

sentences.en: What will happen when someone tells her not to drive, and she decides to do it anyway?
sentences.zh: 当有人告诉她不准开车，而她却决定无论如何都要开时，会发生什么？

sentences.en: Well, that's a very good question,
sentences.zh: 嗯，这真是个好问题，

sentences.en: Bill said, his voice strained.
sentences.zh: 比尔说，声音紧绷。

sentences.en: I mean, that just happened half an hour ago.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这种事半小时前刚发生过。

sentences.en: She's at Walmart right now, buying groceries.
sentences.zh: 她现在正在沃尔玛买杂货呢。

sentences.en: Barb was alone, standing in the front hall of her house, when the letter arrived on September

sentences.zh: 26日，当这封信送达时，巴布正独自站在她家的前厅里。

sentences.en: The letter probably shouldn't have existed at all.
sentences.zh: 这封信本不该存在的。

sentences.en: In most cases, results this consequential are delivered in person.
sentences.zh: 在大多数情况下，如此重大的结果都是当面告知的。

sentences.en: The author of the letter owned up to this, how normally this is against their lab's policy, but given the results, they felt Barb really needed to see it.
sentences.zh: 写这封信的人承认了这一点，这通常违反了他们实验室的政策，但鉴于检测结果，他们觉得巴布真的需要看一看。

sentences.en: Barb had spent eight years not knowing, and a full year dodging calls from the lab since being tested.
sentences.zh: 自从接受检测以来，巴布在八年的时间里一无所知，整整一年都在躲避实验室的电话。

sentences.en: But this envelope was thick enough to prompt the thought, drifting in out of nowhere, that maybe she shouldn't just throw it out.
sentences.zh: 但这个信封厚得让人脑海中突然闪过一个念头：或许她不该就这样把它扔掉。

sentences.en: Even as she opened it and started reading,
sentences.zh: 就在她打开信并开始阅读时，

sentences.en: Barb remained convinced of what it would say and what that would mean for her and everyone who loved her.
sentences.zh: 巴布仍然坚信这封信会写些什么，以及这对她和所有爱她的人意味着什么。

sentences.en: It didn't ever occur to me, she said, that I might get good news.
sentences.zh: 她说，我从来没想过自己可能会得到好消息。

sentences.en: There was at first a wave of disbelief.
sentences.zh: 起初是一阵难以置信的感觉。

sentences.en: Then a call to her husband, which made it more real.
sentences.zh: 接着她给丈夫打了个电话，这让一切变得更加真实。

sentences.en: The two of them cried together over the phone.
sentences.zh: 两人在电话里抱头痛哭。

sentences.en: That night, they told the kids everything.
sentences.zh: 那天晚上，他们把一切都告诉了孩子们。

sentences.en: They were thirteen and eleven at the time.
sentences.zh: 他们当时十三岁和十一岁。

sentences.en: They knew some of their aunts had problems, but they were never told what they were, and they had never asked.
sentences.zh: 他们知道有些阿姨身体有问题，但从没人告诉他们具体是什么问题，他们也从未问过。

sentences.en: Barb sees now how strange that must have been for them to learn about an illness that others in the family would get, but not them.
sentences.zh: 巴布现在明白了，对于孩子们来说，去了解一种家族中其他人会得、而他们不会得的疾病，当时一定觉得很奇怪。

sentences.en: We made them drink champagne with us,
sentences.zh: 我们让他们陪我们喝香槟，

sentences.en: Barb said.
sentences.zh: 巴布说。

sentences.en: So they were like, cool, we get to drink champagne.
sentences.zh: 所以他们当时的反应是，太酷了，我们可以喝香槟了。

sentences.en: It has been a few years since that toaSt.
sentences.zh: 距离那次祝酒已经过去几年了。

sentences.en: Enough time for Barb to think about the years she spent putting off knowing.
sentences.zh: 这段时间足够让巴布去反思她当年选择逃避得知的那些年。

sentences.en: While she understands why she did it, she also now sees how even the possibility of having FTD had changed things for her, limited her world, blunted her ambition,
sentences.zh: 虽然她理解自己当初为什么这样做，但她现在也看清了，哪怕只是存在患上FTD的可能性，也已经改变了她的一切，局限了她的世界，消磨了她的雄心，

sentences.en: blotted out her sense of what was possible for herself and her family.
sentences.zh: 抹杀了她对自己和家人未来的期望。

sentences.en: She thinks of moments at work where she didn't raise her hand, didn't try to accomplish more, didn't want to assume authority, because of the illness she might have,
sentences.zh: 她想起了工作中那些没有举手、没有试图取得更大成就、不想承担管理职责的时刻，原因就是她可能患上的这种疾病，

sentences.en: the symptoms that might emerge any day.
sentences.zh: 以及任何一天都可能爆发的症状。

sentences.en: Would she have asked for more, expected more, if she'd been tested?
sentences.zh: 如果她接受了检测，她会要求更多、期望更高吗？

sentences.en: I think it probably held me back from applying for leadership positions because I was nervous that maybe I wouldn't be able to finish the work or stay in it,
sentences.zh: 她说，我想这可能阻碍我去申请领导岗位，因为我担心自己可能无法完成工作，或者无法坚持下去，

sentences.en: make a multi-year commitment, because what if this disease sets in, she said.
sentences.zh: 无法做出多年的承诺，因为万一这种疾病发作了怎么办。

sentences.en: I think it was all happening on a very subconscious level.
sentences.zh: 我想这一切都是在非常潜意识的层面发生的。

sentences.en: It wasn't until I found out that I didn't have it, and all of a sudden I felt so confident in myself, and that's when I realized that I had been feeling really unconfident
sentences.zh: 直到我发现自己没有得病，突然之间我对自己的信心大增，我才意识到自己其实已经失去了自信

sentences.en: for ten years.
sentences.zh: 整整十年。

sentences.en: She sees how terrified she'd been not just for herself, but for her husband and children, the responsibilities they would have had to shoulder in caring for her, to say nothing
sentences.zh: 她意识到自己不仅为自己感到恐惧，也为丈夫和孩子感到恐惧，恐惧他们不得不承担照顾她的责任，更不用说她的孩子也可能携带突变基因的可能性了。

sentences.en: of the possibility that her children would also have the mutation.
sentences.zh: （此处原文对应前句结尾，按句序独立处理）

sentences.en: Now came the strange feeling that all of that, everything she'd been negotiating in silence for so long, had passed them all by,
sentences.zh: 现在产生了一种奇怪的感觉，所有这一切——她默默纠结了那么久的一切——都与他们擦肩而过了，

sentences.en: car on the highway, hopped the guardrail, and crash.
sentences.zh: 就像高速公路上的汽车撞上护栏然后坠毁那样。

sentences.en: Next for Barb came the guilt, and with it a sense of obligation.
sentences.zh: 接下来对巴布来说是内疚，随之而来的是一种责任感。

sentences.en: Instead of worrying about her own mind and her children's,
sentences.zh: 巴布不再为她自己和孩子的大脑担忧，

sentences.en: Barb spent her days thinking more about those in her family who were suffering.
sentences.zh: 而是把日子花在更多地思考家族中那些正在受苦的亲人身上。

sentences.en: It was hard to talk about me not having it with my siblings, she said.
sentences.zh: 她说，和兄弟姐妹们谈论我没有得病这件事是很困难的。

sentences.en: Of the nine brothers and sisters, five now have active science of FTD.
sentences.zh: 在九个兄弟姐妹中，有五人现在已经出现了明显的FTD症状。

sentences.en: Christy, Mary,
sentences.zh: 克里斯蒂、玛丽、

sentences.en: Jenny, Peggy, and Oliver, the fourth born, four years younger than Christy, who had been behaving strangely for many years until, in his sixties, he dropped out of sight
sentences.zh: 珍妮、佩吉，以及排行老四的奥利弗（比克里斯蒂小四岁，他多年来一直表现异常，直到六十多岁时在大流行期间失联，无家可归并在外面流落了网外生活一年多）。

sentences.en: during the pandemic, homeless and off the grid for more than a year.
sentences.zh: （接上条：流落街头一年多）

sentences.en: These were people who, decades ago, had come to care for Barb when she needed them the most, when their mother died.
sentences.zh: 这些人曾在几十年前巴布最需要他们的时候——当他们的母亲去世时——给予她关爱。

sentences.en: What will happen to them?
sentences.zh: 他们会怎么样？

sentences.en: Whose responsibility were they now?
sentences.zh: 他们现在是谁的责任？

sentences.en: I'd thought long and hard about what's my job here, what's my role in the family,
sentences.zh: 巴布说，我一直在苦思冥想，我在这里的工作是什么，我在家庭中的角色是什么，

sentences.en: Barb said.
sentences.zh: 巴布说。

sentences.en: Maybe if there was one sibling for me to care for, I could do that.
sentences.zh: 也许如果只有一个兄弟姐妹需要我照顾，我还能做到。

sentences.en: But now I'm looking at five, potentially.
sentences.zh: 但现在我面对的可能是五个。

sentences.en: How could I possibly take in five FTD patients?
sentences.zh: 我怎么可能收留五个FTD患者呢？

sentences.en: And if I want to help one of them, how do I choose?
sentences.zh: 如果我想帮其中一个人，我又该怎么选择？

sentences.en: Barb wondered whether the family could chip in for a compound somewhere, a place where everyone could care for one another, pooling resources.
sentences.zh: 巴布琢磨着家里人能不能凑钱在某个地方买个合住的院子，一个大家可以互相照顾、资源共享的地方。

sentences.en: It seemed too complicated to pull off, with so many siblings having to uproot themselves.
sentences.zh: 但要让这么多兄弟姐妹连根拔起搬过去，这操作起来似乎太复杂了。

sentences.en: There are also some who probably wouldn't want to be helped, including Oliver, who worked as a trucker for years until he started having trouble holding onto a job.
sentences.zh: 还有一些人可能根本不想接受帮助，包括奥利弗，他当了多年的卡车司机，直到后来开始难以保住工作。

sentences.en: Like Mary, he developed a habit of dropping in unannounced on relatives all over the country.
sentences.zh: 就像玛丽一样，他养成了在全国各地对亲戚进行不速之客般突然造访的习惯。

sentences.en: Oliver is now in assisted living.
sentences.zh: 奥利弗现在住在辅助生活机构里。

sentences.en: When he resurfaced at a hospital last year,
sentences.zh: 当他去年再次出现在一家医院时，

sentences.en: Susan and her nephew drove 22 hours to bring him to Pittsburgh, and Barb navigated the Medicaid bureaucracy to help find him a place.
sentences.zh: 苏珊和她的侄子开了22小时的车把他送到匹兹堡，芭比则在医疗白内障官僚机构中四处奔走，帮他找了个住处。

sentences.en: His adult daughter,
sentences.zh: 他成年不久的女儿，

sentences.en: Mallory, had persuaded him to grant her and Susan power of attorney a few years earlier.
sentences.zh: 马洛里，几年前曾说服他将自己和苏珊授权为代理人。

sentences.en: But lately, he has been turning away visitors.
sentences.zh: 但最近，他开始拒绝探视者。

sentences.en: It's unclear if he is upset about being there or if his dementia has simply entered a new phase.
sentences.zh: 目前还不清楚他是对身处那里感到沮丧，还是他的痴呆症刚刚进入了新阶段。

sentences.en: Susan dropped off
sentences.zh: 苏珊送来了

sentences.en: Christmas cookies, but he would not come down to accept them.
sentences.zh: 圣诞饼干，但他不肯下楼接受。

sentences.en: Mary's life also seems unsettled.
sentences.zh: 玛丽的生活似乎也动荡不安。

sentences.en: While Christy has become more docile over the years, the family has watched as Mary became more confrontational and even paranoid.
sentences.zh: 虽然克里斯蒂这些年来变得更加温顺，但家人却看着玛丽变得更具对抗性甚至有些偏执。

sentences.en: She divorced a second time and is now living with her third husband in the Pittsburgh area.
sentences.zh: 她经历第二次离婚后，目前和她的第三任丈夫住在匹兹堡地区。

sentences.en: She has stopped returning calls from family members or going to medical appointments with them.
sentences.zh: 她已经不再回复家人的电话，也不跟他们一起去进行医疗预约。

sentences.en: They have no way to know what kind of care she's getting.
sentences.zh: 他们无从得知她正在接受什么样的照顾。

sentences.en: Three of the nine siblings,
sentences.zh: 九个兄弟姐妹中的三个，

sentences.en: Teddy, Mary, and Oliver, did not participate in this article.
sentences.zh: 泰迪、玛丽和奥利弗，没有参与这篇文章。

sentences.en: There's a way in which the entire family has rearranged itself around the disease, some drifting away geographically, others fading away cognitively, and still others
sentences.zh: 某种程度上，整个家族都围绕着这种疾病重新组合了，有的人在地理上渐行渐远，有的人在认知上日渐模糊，还有的人

sentences.en: who are unscathed, desperately trying to hold it all together.
sentences.zh: 毫发无伤，却拼命地想要把这一切维系在一起。

sentences.en: Last Thanksgiving, fifteen members of the family gathered in the Adirondacks, had a rented lodge with a vaulted-ceiling living room and massive stone fireplace, a family compound,
sentences.zh: 去年感恩节，十五名家族成员聚集在阿迪朗达克山脉，租下了一座带挑高起居室和巨大石质壁炉的小木屋，算是一个家族大院，

sentences.en: at least for a few days.
sentences.zh: 至少维持了几天。

sentences.en: Barb and her family were there, as was Kathy, the oldest sibling who doesn't carry the mutation, and her son Charlie, also free of the mutation, along with his wife and son.
sentences.zh: 芭比和她的家人在那里，没有携带突变基因的最年长姐姐凯西以及同样没有携带突变基因的儿子查理（连同他的妻子和儿子）也在那里。

sentences.en: Jenny and her family were there too.
sentences.zh: 珍妮和她的家人也去了。

sentences.en: Barb's children had not seen her in a while.
sentences.zh: 芭比的孩子们已经有一段时间没见她了。

sentences.en: Barb kept an eye on them, noticing them, noticing the changes.
sentences.zh: 芭比一直在留意他们，观察着他们，注意着那些变化。

sentences.en: They're finally seeing what I've been dealing with for twenty years,
sentences.zh: 他们终于看到了我二十年来一直在应付的事情，

sentences.en: Barb said.
sentences.zh: 芭比说。

sentences.en: The siblings were afflicted and the sense of responsibility that carries.
sentences.zh: 兄弟姐妹们饱受病痛折磨，以及随之而来的责任感。

sentences.en: Susan drove eight and a half hours with Christy beside her.
sentences.zh: 苏珊带着克里斯蒂开了八个半小时的车。

sentences.en: In the lodge, most of the family played games, while Christy sat in a soft easy chair by the fire, beaming at everyone.
sentences.zh: 在木屋里，大部分家人都在玩游戏，而克里斯蒂则坐在火炉旁一张柔软的单人沙发上，冲着每个人灿烂地微笑。

sentences.en: I think she enjoys seeing other people and different faces,
sentences.zh: 我想她喜欢看到其他人不同的面孔，

sentences.en: Susan told me a few weeks later, just because I'm the only one that she sees most of the time.
sentences.zh: 几周后苏珊对我说，只是因为平时她见到的只有我一个人。

sentences.en: I believe she remembers us, said Kathy, who lives an hour or so away from Christy and is an occasional backup for Susan.
sentences.zh: 我相信她记得我们，凯西说，她住在离克里斯蒂大约一小时路程的地方，偶尔会替补苏珊照顾她。

sentences.en: I believe she recognizes us.
sentences.zh: 我相信她认得我们。

sentences.en: This will be Susan's twenty-seventh consecutive year as Christy's full-time caregiver.
sentences.zh: 这将是苏珊连续担任克里斯蒂专职照顾者的第二十七个年头。

sentences.en: When Susan started, she was barely out of her thirties, single, and between careers.
sentences.zh: 苏珊刚开始的时候，刚过三十岁，单身，正处于职业生涯的间歇期。

sentences.en: She did not expect her life to take this turn.
sentences.zh: 她没有料到自己的人生会发生这样的转折。

sentences.en: And in all this time, she has demonstrated a capacity for forbearance that others in the family freely admit they lack, a sort of secret reservoir of equanimity she can draw from
sentences.zh: 在这么长的时间里，她展现出了家人都坦言自己不具备的隐忍能力，一种她可以在困难时期

sentences.en: in times of trouble.
sentences.zh: 汲取的平静心境的神秘源泉。

sentences.en: Susan always saves the day in our family,
sentences.zh: 在我们家，苏珊总是能化险为夷，

sentences.en: Barb told me.
sentences.zh: 芭比对我说。

sentences.en: Remarkably,
sentences.zh: 值得一提的是，

sentences.en: Susan has never been tested for the mutation.
sentences.zh: 苏珊从未接受过突变基因检测。

sentences.en: She, too, put off the decision for years, until finally, at sixty-seven, she assumes she simply does not have it.
sentences.zh: 她也把这个决定推迟了多年，直到最后在六十七岁时，她认为自己大概率没有携带。

sentences.en: Instead, she remains focused on caring for her sister.
sentences.zh: 相反，她依然专注于照顾她的姐姐。

sentences.en: Every morning,
sentences.zh: 每天早晨，

sentences.en: Susan rises early, pulls the laundry out of the dryer, tees up all the meals for the day, and makes herself some coffee before waking Christy.
sentences.zh: 苏珊起得很早，把烘干机里的衣服拿出来，把一天的饭菜都备好，在叫醒克里斯蒂之前给自己煮点咖啡。

sentences.en: When Susan coaxes her to the toilet and then to the shower, things go more smoothly when they sing.
sentences.zh: 当苏珊哄她去上厕所然后去洗澡时，如果他们边唱边走，事情就会顺利得多。

sentences.en: The morning I visited, it was
sentences.zh: 我拜访的那天早晨，放的是

sentences.en: Do You Want to Know a Secret by the Beatles.
sentences.zh: 披头士乐队的《你想知道秘密吗》。

sentences.en: She knows the words,
sentences.zh: 她知道歌词，

sentences.en: Susan said, though the most
sentences.zh: 苏珊说，尽管在我拜访期间，克里斯蒂

sentences.en: Christy offered up during my visit was a high, boisterous, humming noise on pitch.
sentences.zh: 最多也只是发出高亢、喧闹且音准准确的哼唱声。

sentences.en: While Barb closely follows the progress of scientific research into FTD,
sentences.zh: 虽然芭比密切关注着额颞叶痴呆症科学研究的进展，

sentences.en: Susan is the emotional glue of the family now, staying close not just with siblings, but with nieces and nephews who are willing to help when they can.
sentences.zh: 但苏珊现在是这个家族的情感纽带，不仅与兄弟姐妹保持紧密联系，还与那些愿意在力所能及的时候提供帮助的侄子侄女保持联系。

sentences.en: Over dinner,
sentences.zh: 晚饭时，

sentences.en: Susan reflected on her time with Christy, but only in fits and starts.
sentences.zh: 苏珊断断续续地回忆起她和克里斯蒂在一起的时光。

sentences.en: I'm not a saint, she told me.
sentences.zh: 我不是圣人，她对我说。

sentences.en: This is devastating.
sentences.zh: 这太令人心碎了。

sentences.en: When the talk shifted to Christy's doctors, the conversation slowed down.
sentences.zh: 当话题转到克里斯蒂的医生身上时，谈话慢了下来。

sentences.en: There was something they weren't saying.
sentences.zh: 有些话他们没有说出口。

sentences.en: Finally,
sentences.zh: 终于，

sentences.en: Susan came out with it.
sentences.zh: 苏珊还是把实情说出来了。

sentences.en: Christy has breast cancer, she said, just like their mother.
sentences.zh: 克里斯蒂患了乳腺癌，她说，就像他们的母亲一样。

sentences.en: That started about a year and a half ago.
sentences.zh: 那是大约一年半前开始的。

sentences.en: There was a sore on her breast and I just decided, you know, we're going to let it go.
sentences.zh: 她胸部有个溃疡，我当时就决定，你知道的，我们顺其自然吧。

sentences.en: Susan was grave when she discussed what that means, how wrangling Christy into a cancer treatment regimen seems too much to ask of her.
sentences.zh: 苏珊在谈到这意味着什么时神情凝重，要让克里斯蒂配合癌症治疗方案似乎对她来说太过勉强。

sentences.en: So they'll continue together for as long as it takes.
sentences.zh: 所以只要能坚持下去，他们就会一直相伴相随。

sentences.en: They had understood for a while that the genetic mutation that took over
sentences.zh: 他们早就明白，夺走

sentences.en: Christy's life may not be what would take that life away.
sentences.zh: 克里斯蒂生命的基因突变，未必会是最终结束她生命的东西。

sentences.en: Now, after all this time, they know how her story will end.
sentences.zh: 现在，经历了这一切，他们知道了她的故事将如何结局。

sentences.en: This week on The Wirecutter Show, we're getting ready for hosting over the holidays.
sentences.zh: 本周的《The Wirecutter Show》节目中，我们正在为假期招待客人做准备。

sentences.en: Tune in for tips on making your guests feel at home.

sentences.en: Are they a blackout sleeper?
sentences.zh: 他们是那种一沾枕头就睡着的人吗？

sentences.en: I don't mean do they black out to go to sleep.
sentences.zh: 我不是指他们会晕厥过去才睡着。

sentences.en: I mean, what kind of light do they require because that is a very specific thing.
sentences.zh: 我是说，他们需要什么样的光线，因为这是一个非常具体的要求。

sentences.en: Do they have allergies, food sensitivities?
sentences.zh: 他们有对什么过敏或饮食禁忌吗？

sentences.en: Are they coffee tea drinkers?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢喝咖啡还是茶？

sentences.en: What time do they like to get up?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢几点起床？
